# audio-recorder-kit

> Browser audio recorder library with realtime waveform callbacks, permission checks, and React hooks bindings.

`@jswork/audio-recorder-kit` is a UI-free, business-agnostic browser audio recording adapter built on Web Audio / MediaDevices. It handles environment and permission detection, a strict recording state machine (start / pause / resume / stop / destroy), WAV Blob + File output with ObjectURL, configurable sample rate / bit depth / channels, realtime waveform and volume payloads, max-duration auto-stop, and reliable resource cleanup. A `./react` subpath exposes `AudioRecorderProvider` plus `useRecorderState`, `useWaveform`, and `usePermission` hooks.

- [src/index.ts](src/index.ts): Core `AudioRecorder` class entry point

- [src/errors.ts](src/errors.ts): `AudioRecorderError` and error codes
- [src/react.tsx](src/react.tsx): React bindings (`AudioRecorderProvider`, hooks) subpath entry
